name: jira-acli
description: acli-first Jira/Confluence toolkit: a pure-mechanics acli skill (bulk work-item ops via JQL, ADF↔markdown conversion) paired with jira-content, which owns the team's canonical templates for Bug/Story/Task/Epic/Sub-task, Confluence Spec/PRD, and comments. Atlassian MCP is the fallback, not the default.
